constraints: Use as the canonical portfolio closing contact/footer surface unless the page documents an exception.
Do not use legacy portfolio Contact for new pages.
verification: Run TypeScript and design-system registry validation.
accessibility: Preserve meaningful heading order, accessible link labels, and visible keyboard focus where interactive.
responsive: Check 1440px, 768px, and 390px; no document overflow. Consumer-specific layout remains local.
semantics: A portfolio page needs the canonical closing contact/footer surface
use_when: A portfolio page needs the canonical closing contact/footer surface
do_not_use_when: A documented product/legal page requires a different footer
public_note: Public-safe composition adaptation. Not identical to private portfolio implementation.
